# Sakib Islam

> Full stack web developer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working alone and remotely, with working hours that overlap the US, UK and Australia. He builds custom websites and web applications (UI/UX, frontend, backend and admin dashboards), WordPress themes and plugins, and looks after live websites. He founded Wrkbase, a team management platform.

## Services

Three service areas, each with its own pages.

### Custom website development

- [Custom website development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/): Websites and online stores built from scratch: UI/UX, frontend, backend and admin dashboard. Websites from $600, stores from $800.
- [Custom web design](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/custom-web-design/): A website designed for your customers and built by the same person. Websites from $600.
- [Ecommerce website development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/ecommerce-website-development/): Custom online stores with their own dashboard for orders and delivery. Stores from $800.
- [Landing page design](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/landing-page-design/): One focused page for one offer, built to load fast on a phone. Quoted per page.
- [Website redesign services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/website-redesign/): A new design and build that keeps the rankings and URLs you already have. Websites from $600.
- [Website speed optimization](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/website-speed-optimization/): Slow pages measured, the cause found and fixed, with before and after numbers. Speed fixes from $150.
- [Website repair](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/website-repair/): A broken, slow or hacked site fixed at the cause, with the cause written down. Repairs from $50.
- [Website maintenance services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/website-maintenance/):  From $149 a month.

### Web application development

- [Web application development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/): Customer portals, internal tools and SaaS: sign-in, roles, dashboards and APIs. First versions from $999.
- [SaaS development services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/saas-development/): A SaaS product from first sketch to launch, with accounts, billing rules and a dashboard. First versions from $999.
- [Customer portal development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/customer-portal-development/): A secure place where your customers sign in to see their own data and requests. First versions from $999.
- [Dashboard development services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/dashboard-development/): Admin dashboards and internal tools that replace spreadsheets and shared inboxes. First versions from $999.
- [MVP development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/mvp-development/): The smallest version of your product that real users can start on. First versions from $999.
- [API integration services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/api-integration/): Payments, email, CRM and couriers connected to your product or website. Quoted per integration, hourly $25/h.
- [AI integration services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/web-application-development/ai-integration/): AI features and agents in your product that ask before they act. Quoted after the brief, hourly $25/h.

- [WordPress development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/): Themes, plugins, stores and payments, built as one job. Themes from $300, stores from $500.
- [Custom WordPress theme development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-theme-development/): A custom WordPress theme built from your Figma design, not a bought theme bent to fit. Theme builds from $300.
- [WordPress plugin development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-plugin-development/): A custom plugin for the one thing no existing plugin does properly. Plugins from $200.
- [WooCommerce development services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/woocommerce-development/): WooCommerce stores with a custom theme, checkout and payment setup. Stores from $500.
- [WordPress speed optimization](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-speed-optimization/): A slow WordPress site measured, the cause found and fixed, with before and after numbers. Speed fixes from $150.
- [WordPress repair](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-repair/): A broken site fixed at the cause, with the cause written down. Repairs from $50.
- [Malware removal](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-malware-removal/): A hacked site cleaned by hand, and the way in closed. Cleanup from $99.
- [WordPress maintenance services](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/wordpress-maintenance/):  From $149 a month.
- [White label WordPress development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/white-label-wordpress-development/):  $20 an hour or $300 a site.
- [White label WordPress support](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/white-label-wordpress-maintenance/):  From $59 per site a month.

## Case studies

- [Mayabee](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/mayabee/): custom online shop for a Dhaka handbag and jewellery brand, in English and Bangla, with an admin dashboard for orders, delivery and cash on delivery
- [Tabby](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/tabby/): Figma to WordPress build for an AI bookkeeping product, Core Web Vitals above 90
- [TubeOnAI](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/tubeonai/): a WordPress site that kept going down, fixed; load time from 5 seconds to 1.5
- [Moneybag](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/moneybag/): custom WordPress payment gateway plugin and website
- [Wrkbase](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/wrkbase/): his own SaaS team management platform with an AI agent
- [Open Alliance Learning](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/open-alliance-learning/): WordPress LMS with dashboards for learners, teachers and assessors
